source_scope: Exact-ID membership proposals only. Names are labels, not membership detectors. Every included ID has an exact Wiki join or is linked by the cited source page's explicit component list; unjoined IDs are called out separately and are not propagated by name.

set_catalog_baseline.note: These existing exact-ID groups were present in ItemSetCatalog and are recorded as baseline coverage. This audit did not independently verify every member.

proposals.name: Angler outfit
proposals.evidence: The Skilling equipment page identifies the Angler outfit as a four-piece Fishing set; the Angler top page identifies item ID 13259 and its set membership.

proposals.name: Spirit angler outfit
proposals.evidence: The Skilling equipment page explicitly lists the Spirit angler set's four pieces and states each piece converts from the corresponding Angler piece. Keep this as a separate color/style set and retain the per-slot conversion relationship.

proposals.name: Farmer's outfit
proposals.evidence: The Skilling equipment and Farmer Gricoller's Rewards pages list the outfit components. The reward page says jacket and shirt are body-type alternatives; preserve those IDs and do not treat them as two simultaneously required slots.
proposals.caveat: Exact-ID duplicates/variants remain separate rows; page component lists describe the semantic slots, not that every alternate is worn at once.

proposals.name: Carpenter's outfit
proposals.evidence: The Skilling equipment page lists the four-piece Construction set; the Mahogany Homes reward page names each component and describes each as a piece of the Carpenter's outfit.

proposals.name: Zealot's robes
proposals.evidence: The Skilling equipment page lists the four pieces as the Zealot's Prayer set; the item pages and collection-log entries use the same exact component names. The set has a prayer utility effect even though it has no ordinary combat bonus, so keep it as useful equipment.

proposals.name: Smiths' Uniform
proposals.evidence: The Smiths' Uniform page lists these four pieces and their skilling effects. The matching blacksmith's helm is explicitly excluded from the outfit.
proposals.upgrade_evidence: Smiths gloves (i) combines Smiths gloves with Ice gloves and is separately storable; model it as a same-slot upgraded glove, not a fifth outfit slot.

proposals.name: Raiments of the Eye
proposals.evidence: The exact-ID item pages join to the Raiments of the Eye page, which lists the base components and red, green, and blue variants; the outfit grants extra runes and can be stored in a magic wardrobe.
proposals.unresolved_note: These effective catalog IDs have no exact-ID Wiki fact in this joined snapshot. They may be related variants, but the audit does not inherit membership from similar names.

proposals.name: Golden prospector kit
proposals.evidence: The Skilling equipment page lists four Golden prospector components and says each is made by applying a star fragment to its regular Prospector piece. Keep it as an alternate styled set linked by exact slot.

proposals.name: Woodland camouflage gear
proposals.evidence: The Wiki set page names exactly these two pieces and describes the top and legs' weight-reduction effects. It also says the set can be stored in the costume-room armour case.

proposals.name: Jungle camouflage gear
proposals.evidence: The Wiki item pages and Hunter gear table identify the Jungle camouflage top/legs as a two-piece Hunter gear set.

proposals.name: Desert camouflage gear
proposals.evidence: The Wiki item pages and Hunter gear table identify the Desert camouflage top/legs as a two-piece Hunter gear set.

proposals.name: Polar camouflage gear
proposals.evidence: The Wiki item pages and Hunter gear table identify the Polar camouflage top/legs as a two-piece Hunter gear set.

proposals.name: Ballista javelin ammunition
proposals.evidence: Every listed ID has a unique exact-page/subpage Wiki equipment-slot=ammo match. Wiki combat pages identify javelins as ammunition fired by ballistae. Current catalog subcategory/tag is generic GEAR/gear, so the existing Ammunition tag misses them.
proposals.caveat: Poison states remain exact separate item IDs. Ammunition-slot membership alone is not the detector: the slot also contains blessings and utility items.

proposals.name: Brutal arrows
proposals.evidence: Each exact-ID page has the positive Arrows category and a unique ammunition slot record. The Rune brutal page directly states its bow compatibility and gives ranged strength +60 (item ID 4803). All seven are currently CLEANUP/cleanup, so they miss the combat ammunition grouping.

proposals.name: Barbed bolts
proposals.evidence: Exact item page is categorized as Bolts and has a unique equipment-slot=ammo record; the Wiki Bolts page identifies barbed bolts among crossbow ammunition. Current classification is SKILLING/raw-resources.

proposals.name: Barbarian Assault arrows
proposals.evidence: Exact pages are Arrows and ammo-slot items, and identify these as Barbarian Assault role-only arrows used against Penance Fighters/Rangers. Preserve their ammunition identity and consider an explicit activity set; do not infer that they are general banked combat ammunition.
proposals.workflow_destination: ambiguous; current source facts establish activity-only use but not the preferred Ironman bank tab

explicit_non_propagation_cases.name: Mith grapple
explicit_non_propagation_cases.decision: Keep its traversal-tool role. The Bolts page says it is used with a crossbow to grapple agility shortcuts and obstacles. Ammunition-slot and Bolts-category facts do not make it combat ammo.

explicit_non_propagation_cases.name: Rada's blessings
explicit_non_propagation_cases.decision: Keep wearable diary-reward identity. They occupy the ammunition slot but provide equipped prayer/fishing effects, not ranged ammunition.
